docs.title: $200–$400
docs.text: Assumes: existing PC/console, display, desk

docs.title: Target user
docs.text: • Curious after F1 Arcade, want to try a wheel at home for minimum money

docs.title: Parts
docs.text:
• Logitech G923 bundle: wheel + rim + 3 pedals, gear drive ~2.3 Nm
  • Desk clamp (in box) + pedal stop: wall or shoebox
  • Alt: Moza R3 3.9 Nm DD $279–339 (PC/Xbox, no PS) / Thrustmaster T248 $240–400 / T128 $200

docs.title: Footprint
docs.text:
• Existing desk ~120×60 cm, wheel clamps to edge
  • Pedals on floor against wall or box

docs.title: What it feels like
docs.text:
• Grainier FFB than F1 Arcade, no motion
  • Unlimited seat time
  • Slower than controller for the first week

docs.title: Pros / cons
docs.text:
• +: cheapest way in, nothing to build or store
  • −: pedals slide, desk flex — no load-cell pedals yet

docs.title: Next upgrade
docs.text: • Tier 1 foldable or wheel stand

docs.title: Used-market alternative
docs.text:
• G29/G920 ~$150–200; check pot jitter + gear slack
  • Avoid G27 (no PS5/Xbox)

docs.title: Related pages
docs.text: • Tier 1 — Foldable / Apartment

docs.title: $500–$700
docs.text: Assumes: existing PC/console, display, foldable space

docs.title: Target user
docs.text:
• Hooked after Tier 0, or sure you'll stick with it
  • Apartment / shared room — rig must disappear

docs.title: Parts
docs.text:
• Moza R5 bundle: 5.5 Nm direct drive, ES rim, 2-pedal Hall set — $379 sale
  • Playseat Challenge X: foldable, carbon steel — $299
  • Console: G923 $350 (PS/Xbox); PS direct drive: Thrustmaster T598 5 Nm $466–500
  • Alt: NLR Wheel Stand 2.0 $279 (use your chair)

docs.title: Footprint
docs.text:
• Challenge X in use: 140×60×105 cm, 11.1 kg
  • Folds with wheel attached
  • Wheel stand option: ~100×60 cm + own chair

docs.title: What it feels like
docs.text:
• First real seating position
  • Direct drive FFB — big step up from gear/belt
  • Wheel deck flex visible above ~8 Nm

docs.title: Pros / cons
docs.text:
• +: folds away, proper position, DD wheel
  • −: still flex, no load-cell brake yet

docs.title: Next upgrade
docs.text:
• Keep the R5, move to fixed Tier 2 rig
  • Add SR-P2 load-cell pedals ($149) once hard-mounted

docs.title: Used-market alternative
docs.text: • Original Playseat Challenge ~$120–180; check straps + plastic wheel-deck clamp
